search_record.judgement: No public forecast of a CUT at this meeting was located. The only sustained public case for lower rates is the administration's pressure campaign - the President, Vice President and Treasury Secretary urging the Fed not to raise and in some cases to cut. Per the operator's standing ruling, political advocacy is not a forecast: an interested party demanding an outcome is not a public case that the outcome will occur, and the advocates state no basis, no probability and no falsification. The contemporaneous reporting says so directly - Federal News Network, 2026-09-08: 'Despite Trump's pressure campaign to cut the rates, no one thinks the Fed will do that.' Recorded rather than written as a thesis; nothing was reconstructed from the market's own question, price or structure (v1.12).
